related.title: U-Net 多尺度分割網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵；U-Net 多尺度分割網路改以收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations; U-Net multiscale segmentation network centers on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照卷積stem與shape與影像與像素標籤，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到U-Net 多尺度分割網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以類別與移轉失效為起點，設計一項能區分「殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵」與「收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare convolutional stem and shapes with images and pixel labels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to U-Net multiscale segmentation network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from class and transfer failures and propose an observation distinguishing residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations from contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, including uncertainty.

related.title: 深度 MLP 與自動編碼器
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵；深度 MLP 與自動編碼器改以全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。

practice: 對照卷積stem與shape與MLP weight與bias，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到深度 MLP 與自動編碼器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以類別與移轉失效為起點，設計一項能區分「殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵」與「全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare convolutional stem and shapes with mlp weights/biases and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Deep MLP and autoencoder, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from class and transfer failures and propose an observation distinguishing residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations from dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction, including uncertainty.

history.title: ResNet 殘差視覺網路
history.text: ResNet 殘差視覺網路的公開資料展示殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for ResNet residual vision network illustrate residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.

roles.business: 經營 Windows、Azure 雲端、Entra 身分、資安與 GitHub。

roles.role: 提供 GPU 與 cuDNN，ResNet 訓練與推論的主要平台。
roles.roleEn: Provides GPUs and cuDNN, the main platform for ResNet training and inference.
roles.business: 設計 GPU、加速運算平台、資料中心網路與 AI 軟體堆疊。
roles.businessEn: Designs GPUs, accelerated-computing platforms, data-centre networking and the AI software stack.

courses.connection: 從「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in ResNet residual vision network. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
